resources.string: Tap to set the cache window for your next message: 1h, 5m, off. It applies to one message sent directly; a queued message leaves the choice in place. The clock follows the last reply on this branch that the server marked. Hold the pill to read this again.
This route sends a five-minute window. The clock follows the last reply on this branch that the server marked.
